reviews.text:
Zero empathy and humanity.
I arrived with my 19-year-old cat bleeding from the nose and who hadn't eaten for two days (my vet wasn't admitting him, and this one had been recommended to me). As a favor, they told me a vet (who wasn't at fault and was very polite, named Pablo) would see him. They told me he needed urgent admission/hospitalization, but they were short-staffed and had no room to admit him. While I was there with my cat, they encouraged me to go to other hospitals (on the other side of Madrid). I insisted on waiting there for a few hours until they were less busy, and they refused. I asked to speak to a supervisor to explain the situation and ask them to please admit him, since I was an hour away from home, and they refused because they were busy. Interestingly, all the waiting rooms and the hospital admissions area (at 12:30 pm) are completely empty… I don't recommend it; it seems they only cater to appointments, and they don't care about emergencies or new arrivals.

Although it was the hospital where I had to let my dog ​​go, the care I've received there is unlike anything I've seen in human hospitals. I'm so grateful to everyone—doctors, residents, students, administrative staff, and even the janitors! Highly recommended for any specialty.

Excellent care and professionalism. I went for a second opinion with neurologists Carmen and Miriam and realized that you should leave your local vet for minor ailments, as all they want is to take advantage of your good nature. This hospital offers advanced treatments that save pets a lot of suffering, as well as time and money for their owners. It's well worth it.

I went on Saturday morning, since my vet was closed and this clinic had been recommended to me. Well, the recommendation was a complete failure. I went there, since it's a teaching hospital where they train as veterinarians, because of a problem with my dog's eye. She had a stitched eyelid due to an ulcer. A stitch came loose and was bothering her eye. So, here's my experience. First, they told me they didn't have an ophthalmologist available that day to examine her, and asked why I didn't take her somewhere else. When I insisted, two guys came out—we were seen in the hallway, not in a proper examination room, right there in front of everyone. These guys told me they couldn't see anything and to wait for someone else, a woman named Alicia, who would tell me more. This woman came out and looked at the dog to check for anything wrong, and she confirmed that she couldn't see anything either. When I got home to put in the eye drops, since I don't know anything about this stuff, I found the stitch on my dog's eyelid. At 5:00 PM, I was in a clinic downtown, asleep, having the stitch that was causing me pain removed. I have the medical report, in case anyone doubts it, and the time. And the time I arrived that morning at this so-called hospital, since someone took my information.

In conclusion: they got rid of us in a terrible way. The service was awful, and we're talking about a place where you're supposed to be teaching and learning. The treatment we received was shameful. A real disgrace.
Excellent professionals.

As you can see from another woman's comment, my dog ​​had lymphoma and the exact same thing happened to him as to Alicia's dog (a woman who shared her experience previously). The people in charge on Sunday and Monday (a holiday) didn't give us accurate information about our dog's condition. Even one of the interns/students (that's what it seemed like based on her knowledge), Bea, spoke to us very rudely and disrespectfully in the hours leading up to our beloved dog's death.

I'm truly disappointed because I had complete faith in this veterinarian.
The most heartbreaking thing of all was that yesterday, the day they picked up my dog's body, the staff at the veterinary clinic gave him back a collar that wasn't his. I find this incredibly inconsiderate to a family grieving their loss, and the veterinarian, Elena, hasn't answered our calls in over 48 hours.
All of this reflects the lack of commitment they've shown throughout this entire process. I hope you will take this information into account before taking your pets to this place.

Honestly, it was awful. After spending an hour and a half going around in circles because the signage is so poor—Google said there were emergency services available from September 2nd, but they told us there were no openings until the 14th—we told them to please tell us that our dog was suffering from respiratory failure and heart problems, but they did nothing. Is that how much they care about animals? I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. A terrible experience, and the Google information was awful; they don't even bother to update it.

I wasted my time taking my dog ​​to the veterinary clinic when it's closed in August, even though it says it's open 24 hours. Imagine my face with my dog ​​practically dead, wandering the hospital corridors, and they're on vacation!

Neurology - Carmen.
After two months with her and repeatedly requesting an MRI for my dog, her diagnosis was to schedule another appointment in September. She refused to refer me to the neurological center in Getafe with which they collaborate.
I wasn't going to wait, so I went to Veterios. In two days, I received the diagnosis for my dog ​​that she hadn't been able to determine in two months.
I hope she becomes a better teacher to future veterinarians than she is as a neurologist for dogs.

I was advised to come to the emergency room from the clinic, and I find out that today they're only seeing, literally, COWS, and only for emergencies. The man even looked at my cat carrier, just in case the cow was inside. Shameful. Not even 24 hours or anything.

It's impossible to get through on the phone during emergency hours. The landline rings a few times and a recorded message tells you they're busy and to send an email, and the mobile phone is always switched off.

The in-person service isn't bad.
Exceptional treatment and great professionalism towards the animals

A must-visit for your pet. Whatever their breed, they're experts with incredible knowledge. Since it's a university, students are always watching and they take the time to explain everything to both you and them.
A perfect 10 experience.

My family and I had a really good experience here. Our Miniature Schnauzer was diagnosed with Portosystemic Shunts (PSS). They did all the testing at a very reasonable cost.

The operation too was actually well over 50% cheaper than other hospitals. This doesn’t mean less quality either. The staff here are highly trained and skilled and know exactly what they’re doing.

Our dog had a very successful surgery here and is recovering really well.

I also have to say that all the staff there are wonderful from the front desk to the assistant ls to the doctors to the surgeons were all amazing.

I speak limited Spanish so I was able to talk to then in English too 😊

Thank you so much to everyone at the hospital from my family and I 🐾
Excellent professionals, very competent. And they are very caring towards animals.
The best hospital I've ever been to
Excellent service, everything was very fast and the professionals were incredible, not to mention the prices are very reasonable. Thank you so much, I'm very grateful.

Special mention to María Suárez and her team. They are wonderful.
The clinic itself is good, but the management is poor. They charge, make mistakes, and take 3-4 months to refund the erroneously charged amount via bank transfer.
A great professional who takes good care of animals

The veterinary hospital is closed at night, so I would appreciate it if you could change the sign that says "open 24 hours." I went to the emergency room with my dog ​​on Sunday, and when I arrived, it was closed.
They are very good, perfect for your pet
They provide veterinary consultations at lower prices than other private veterinary clinics.
Good service, good price and absolute trustworthiness.

We took our dog in serious condition, from the first moment both the speed and the human quality of the treatment has been unbeatable, they take very good care of the animals and at all times they explain to you how the situation is and how they are going to deal with it.

The professionals are good, however, the prices are as high as, or even higher than, a private clinic, which doesn't make much sense considering that some of their staff are students. Furthermore, punctuality is nonexistent, and they are inflexible with appointments for check-ups.

My veterinary clinic recommended them to me as an option, always implying that I could be turned away since it's an educational institution. I arrived there in an emergency on a Sunday with my dog ​​Queen, who was paraplegic, completely unfamiliar with the place and the people I would find. And although my dog ​​never left, I can say that the people working and learning there are the most honest and dedicated to their work I've ever met. I'm so glad I went there with Queen that Sunday; she was undoubtedly surrounded by the best people. If I ever had to go back, I would, or if someone I know were in a similar situation, I would recommend this hospital.
Excellent service, fast, and above all, the price!
Excellent service. Perfect treatment of animals and good facilities.
Diego Troya's care was outstanding, and in the emergency room, Clara was also incredibly empathetic, making a painful situation pass calmly. I am extremely grateful.
The veterinary service was very good, but the reception staff chatted instead of attending to the clients.
Excellent service, professional staff. The students were very engaged.

Great professionals and commendable dedication.
In my case, I don't know how it will all end, but I must highlight the care, perseverance, and enthusiasm they're showing for my case. At least they're interested in understanding why my cat is in need and doing something about it. At other places (like Anicura), they would have given her up for dead as soon as they saw her.
Always great
A real pleasure, very professional and with very kind and patient staff, highly recommended
Although our little one couldn't make it, I have to thank the hospital staff for everything they did for him.
Super professional, they take care of the animals with great affection and respect, and above all, they are friendly but very, very professional.

I took my dog ​​for a simple procedure, and the result was very unsatisfactory. The wound was very large and poorly stitched.
The worst hospital and very bad treatment.
Fantastic service

I would like to know how I can get an appointment. I've sent an appointment request and no one has responded, nor are they answering my calls. I see that the reviews on this page are all very favorable, and I urgently need my pet examined there because of a lump (I don't trust "commercial" veterinary clinics). I'm afraid to show up without an appointment in case they refuse to see me. Can anyone help me?...Thank you
They saved our cat's life. We are so grateful for the care and dedication of the entire team.
Excellent care and treatment of both us and our dog. The consultation with the neurologist specialist was incredibly professional and friendly. 100% recommended. Complete confidence.
I received excellent service; several specialists examined my dog ​​and the explanation was perfect. Thank you.

I took my cat to the vet for a back problem. The tests from the private vet weren't accepted; they had to repeat them all (and I had to pay for them again) to arrive at the same result: they didn't know what was wrong with her. Diagnosis: It must be something neurological, but they couldn't tell me what because the cat wouldn't let them examine her (of course!! She's a cat and it hurts, she's not a stuffed animal). Finally, I went to a third vet. He took an X-ray with her legs open and discovered it was a problem in her pelvis (femoral head). There was no solution, but if the first vet took a lateral X-ray and it didn't show anything, why repeat it? Why not take one with her legs open to see the pelvis? Except for one young vet who was kind to my pet, the rest of the vets were apathetic and showed no interest (and the only comment I can make about the neurologist is that she needs to see one herself).
Exceptional service, attentive and professional. Without a doubt, the best and most trustworthy place to take my dogs.

We took my dog ​​Lola in when she was very sick. She was diagnosed with pancreatitis. She spent four days there, and all I can say is thank you so much for everything. The staff were wonderful and so caring with the other pets. True professionals. I always take her there, and it's always been great. But I've never been to the emergency room before, and I've always been delighted. Thank you so much for everything.
They arrive on time and are good professionals.
Speed, efficiency and professionalism.

We took my dog ​​to the emergency vet on a Sunday without an appointment, and although they told us they couldn't guarantee she'd be seen, they did their best and ended up treating her. The care and affection they showed her demonstrated their passion for what they do. We were very happy with how they treated my dog. Highly recommended.
They are professional, attentive to people and, above all and fundamentally, to animals, from the students, the assistants and of course the veterinary specialists.
The appointment system has improved after being chaotic for months. Don't go to the emergency room; they won't treat you if you don't have a record there, no matter how serious your condition is.

Excellent professionals. I've tried several specialties: gastroenterology, oncology, trauma, dentistry, general medicine, and exotic animals, and I have no complaints. I have complete confidence in them. The staff are highly trained professionals, and the students present assist the doctors while learning as they go. They have good equipment for tests. The price is cheaper than at other hospitals.
Beautiful, beautiful
The best professionals, without a doubt.
Excellent service.
Dr. Jesús Rodríguez, surgeon and traumatologist, is a great professional.

I took my dog ​​in when he was very sick, and he had to stay for a few days. After that, he recovered.
They provide the best possible care for animals and are very attentive to people.
It will definitely be my go-to hospital.
Very good service but a tad expensive
Professionals who are very dedicated to their cases, very warm and provide excellent service.

It's taken me a long time to write a review of the veterinary hospital.

Why is that? My first thought is that it was too important to do quickly.

I let time pass. I connected with how my pet, Simbo, connects with time. He's in no hurry; when we walk, he stops, sniffs at the stimuli around him, and moves on to others without time being the crucial factor. It seems they simply keep each other company.

The Complutense University Veterinary Hospital seems to have absorbed this way of interpreting time.

It doesn't seem human, intelligent; it's animal, body, feeling, and companionship.

It's the best Human Hospital of Humility for Humanity.

We went to the hospital on the recommendation of an acquaintance, and despite our cat Maxi's passing, the experience was very positive.

I want to highlight the excellent care and professionalism of the neurologist Carmen and her team, including Jorge, who was with us in our cat's final moments, and another colleague whose name I don't know, who saw us in the afternoons. We felt supported, informed, and above all, we felt their desire to save Maxi, but unfortunately, it wasn't possible.

I wish we had come here from the beginning.

Thank you all very much.

P.S.: To the Manager: In our case, it wasn't ultimately necessary, but for those animals that need it, I believe that a center like the one you manage should have an MRI machine. I know it's currently out of order; please look into this matter, as I'm sure many would be grateful.

Regards.

After several months of struggling without finding a clear solution, we were fortunate enough to fall into the hands of Dr. Carmen Lorente Méndez's team. I have no words to express my gratitude for the incredibly professional, friendly, and compassionate care they provided. They are top-notch professionals who have restored our peace of mind. We are truly grateful and delighted with the care we received. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for taking such good care of Oso!

The care provided by the doctors and veterinary trainees was exceptional. Their affection and patience with the animals is remarkable, and they gave us excellent information. The veterinary surgeon who treated us was outstanding.
We were seen quite quickly. The consultation fee is the same as at any other vet, although procedures are somewhat cheaper.
No idea, I went to an exam

Fantastic. Very kind, efficient, and above all, effective.
I had a minor issue with my dog, and they handled it brilliantly. They're truly excellent. Highly recommended.

I highly recommend it. Many of us were hesitant because it's a university clinic, since when it comes to pets, you want the best care and assume they're run by students. That's not the case. They usually work in groups of 4-5 students, supervised by a veterinarian who is also a professor. This professor is experienced and sees the patients. They're very friendly, have an email address for any questions or emergencies, and it's much cheaper than a traditional vet. They have a separate area for exotic animals and another for cats, the latter being quite secluded. If you're considering a second opinion on any issue with your pet, I highly recommend coming here.
Charming and the service was exquisite.
Excellent service, very polite staff with outstanding professionals
Spectacularly beautiful
The traumatology department, which is the one I used, is wonderful. The professionals are outstanding and they have everything you could possibly need.
A very professional team. They try to help you in every way possible to give your pet the best care.

To Paloma, the "lady" in the comment below.

What's not fair is that a hospital on the verge of collapse due to staff shortages has to treat a non-life-threatening emergency because you don't want to go to another hospital, possibly for financial reasons. If you're told you can't be treated and other places are recommended, it will be for justifiable reasons, as I understand it, being a pet owner and a hospital user.

I feel sorry for your dog, and for the owner she's stuck with.
Great service, good price, and good results.

Terrible service. My mother took my kitten to the emergency vet and there was no one there to help. If their website says they're open 24 hours, they should honor that. If she were in worse condition, she would have died...
The doctor is amazing, she explains things so well and she's so didactic.

The medical professionals were excellent, but the reception staff were awful, celebrating one of their birthdays and making us wait longer than usual even to pay for the photo session they were having at a supposed photocall 😡 …

I took my 6-year-old dog, who has lymphoma, to the vet. He had completed chemotherapy sessions and was in remission. He seemed happy, full of life, and strong. They told me he should continue with the chemotherapy, which we attended regularly. The last chemo session was on Tuesday, and he was fine until Thursday. On Friday, he started vomiting and having diarrhea.

I took him to the emergency room, and they told me his stomach and intestines were paralyzed. They put him on fluid therapy. His neutrophil count was extremely low. Except for the doctor on Friday and half of Saturday, the rest were very insensitive, unprofessional, and didn't seem to know what was happening or what they were doing. I asked them to contact his oncologist, and they told me she didn't answer emails. I wrote to the oncologist, and there was no response. I went to see him twice a day, and he was disgusting, with feces stuck to his rear end. It was so bad that I asked if I could bathe him, and they agreed to give me a bucket of soapy water. On Sunday, they told me they would do an ultrasound on Tuesday and that he could be discharged on Friday.
On Monday night, I went to see him. I waited for them to take him out, and after an hour, they told me he was in surgery. I asked them to explain, and the student told me she wasn't authorized to say anything because she was a student. Finally, they let me in, and I saw him lying down, his vital signs monitored because he had become unstable. I called my family so they could say goodbye. My husband arrived and asked the "doctor," who said her name was Bea, what they had done to my dog, since he had gone from walking around at midday to being bedridden with tubes. This Bea woman became rude and almost shouted that they hadn't done anything to the dog. Terrible handling of the situation; she mistreated both the pet and the owners.
They called me in the middle of the night to say he had suffered a cardiac arrest. Not even an "I'm sorry," nothing.

I then wrote to the oncologist three times because, to cope with the loss, I wanted to know what happened… there were so many unanswered questions.
My impression during the chemo appointments was different; I thought the professionals were on vacation… but it seems that weekend and holiday emergency rooms are a different story. I'm giving it one star because I can't give it less than that.

I really love the hospital. I take my two kittens there, and they're always very attentive and caring. They also research and order tests to confirm the diagnosis. The veterinarians are always present for appointments and are incredibly experienced. I have a lot of confidence in them! My kitten Faisca is still alive thanks to the accurate diagnosis. I always recommend them.

As a hospital, I have no complaints, but this review is about the situation that occurred today. I want to make it clear that the owners are completely innocent.
Donor dogs were needed for a transfusion, and a lot of people were mobilized. By the time several arrived, luckily there was already a donor.
I can understand that they don't have a blood bank or that, being altruistic, they don't reimburse us for our time and gas, but since we're there, the least they could do is a blood type test. And they should keep a list of potential candidates for future situations.

Because as it is, all they're doing is discouraging people from coming forward in similar situations. Not to mention the phone; they don't answer either the regular line or the emergency number.

I went for an evaluation and a second opinion. I've never left a consultation more disappointed. My cat has recently been suffering from an upset stomach, and the vet's response rests on two arguments: 1. Wet food should be restricted in cats' diets. And 2. Cats must consume grains in their diet.

The strange thing is that no vet has recommended low-quality food like supermarket brands, whose main ingredients are grains and starches. According to him, it's because there are studies that suggest it. I asked him about the ideal protein-to-grain ratio, and he didn't know the answer.

While it's true that some studies suggest that restricting grain consumption in dogs and cats may be related to dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), there is no conclusive evidence that eliminating grains alone causes heart problems. That's why nowadays, commercial pet food is often enriched with amino acids like taurine. There is no direct link whatsoever between grain consumption and DCM.

On the other hand, all the veterinarians have suggested I add wet food to his diet, since these animals don't drink much water during the day, and this would help prevent urinary problems.

From now on, I'll feed my cat Purina dry food without wet food, just as the vet instructed. We'll see how healthy he is in a few years.

I went with my dog, who had undergone emergency surgery at another hospital—and I must say, the operation was perfect—to the oncology department for a second opinion because the diagnosis was very bad. The care from the students and the doctor afterward was impeccable. Everything was explained perfectly. Although my dog ​​is beyond help, it's appreciated that they didn't try to squeeze money out of us for anything.
I only know the cattle area, but they have always been very professional.
Thank you for the attention and professionalism from the moment you walk in the door until you leave. We will definitely return when we need you again.
The perfect place to take your pets. Don't hesitate to visit if you need to see a veterinarian.

I had to take my kitten to the veterinary consultation area within the hospital (note that the entrance to the consultation rooms is separate from the main veterinary hospital entrance) because he's not fully recovering, and I can honestly say that the service there is excellent, from the ultrasound technicians to the veterinarians... I really appreciate their friendly approach and support. 😊 Thank you.
They were excellent veterinarians. My dog ​​sadly passed away, but they were very kind and understanding. 💗 …
Okay, that's all.

What wonderful people! I'm so grateful, and I highly recommend them to everyone. They're efficient, professional, provide excellent service, and are incredibly generous. When things go well, you feel grateful, and this is my way of saying thank you. The students are lovely too. A true pleasure.

I'm very disappointed. I took my dog ​​to the emergency vet in January because he had bladder stones, and they treated him very well. The surgery was excellent, and everything was fine up to that point. But then he needed to see a specialist, in this case a nephrologist, for post-operative care and follow-up. I made two appointments, but due to personal circumstances, I couldn't attend, and I notified them. For the last appointment in July, I called to let them know, but since it's extremely difficult to get through, they didn't answer the phone, so I couldn't contact them. They were closed in August, and in September, I tried to make another appointment, but they told me I couldn't make any more appointments because the nephrologist refuses to see me. I find it unbelievable. I might have made a mistake with the appointments, which is debatable since they never answer the phone, but what did the animal do wrong? It has a chronic illness that requires follow-up care from a specialist, and this woman is denying it. Her refusal to see me is incredibly unprofessional and shows a profound lack of compassion for animals. It's unbelievable that she works with them. In eight months, I've called countless times just to get her to tell me how to feed the animal after the surgery, and she's never even replied. This makes it even clearer that this woman couldn't care less about animals.
They treat your pet incredibly well and take excellent care of them. Super professional. A trustworthy place to take your little one.

First visit with Miguel Angel Cabezas and he seems like a true professional. He took all the time necessary to explain the case in detail, and he was clearly committed to following up on it.
In short, a 10/10 first visit.

A huge thank you to the entire team who assessed, performed emergency surgery on, and cared for my one-year-old cat, Kevin, during his hospital stay. He had swallowed a thread that was lacerating and practically severing his intestinal wall, and he was very ill. I had never been to this place before, and in just two hours, despite the large number of animals in the emergency room and clinics, they were already operating on him. Thanks to you, he's home with us, healed, and as affectionate and playful as ever. Besides being incredibly professional, I am so grateful for the care and attention you give to the animals and their families.
Grateful for the great service, and Mini too!
I came in for an emergency. The vet's response was, "We can't treat her because she doesn't have a card." My dog's life depends on a card. The woman who works there was also incredibly rude.

Today I went to the hospital for the first time; I took my kitten. He had been treated there before. It's a wonderful hospital for our furry friends. The staff is wonderful, from reception onwards. Thank you!
Excellent professionals
Professionalism, good service. Spacious premises with gardens.

DISAPPOINTED is an understatement. On June 9th, I requested an appointment, explaining the entire case, results, tests performed, etc., and attaching them. It's perfectly clear that it's a digestive issue. They didn't contact me until the 12th (by email) to tell me I had an appointment on the 25th with a general practitioner and for an ultrasound, when it turns out that's not the specialty we need, and we've already had no fewer than three ultrasounds. They asked me to confirm by replying to that same email. Well, I replied to that same email indicating that the requested specialty was digestive and that we already have several ultrasounds done. They NEVER responded. On the 20th, I contacted them again to confirm that the appointment would be with a digestive specialist. They NEVER responded.
Today, the 23rd, they called and said it was to confirm the appointment with a general practitioner and the ultrasound. I told them no, that we told them from the beginning that we need a digestive specialist and that we've contacted them several times to say so without receiving a single response. The girl wouldn't even let me speak on the phone, constantly saying, "Oh, what a shame, we didn't hear about it. Yes, there were openings for the gastroenterologist, but not anymore, nothing until September." I told her that couldn't be right, that we'd been waiting since the 9th and it was urgent. She said, "I'll cancel the appointment for tomorrow, goodbye," and hung up. We have NEVER seen such SHAMEFUL service. Wasting people's time and jeopardizing the health of their pets. You don't care about anything; you make a mistake and you're not even capable of fixing it.
A very satisfying experience. Excellent professionals, personalized attention. My pet received the best care. Highly recommended.
I highly recommend it, 100%.
I've been taking my dog ​​there for years, but recently for oncology and endocrinology checkups. The care is outstanding.
The best place for your pet.
Professionals, it's clear they love their job.

Great professionals and wonderful people. As a fellow veterinarian who has visited the hospital, I can attest that they take their work very seriously and give their all in every case. Excellent facilities. Congratulations!

I would give it 5 stars if it weren't for my very disappointing experience with the nephrology service. Despite the excellent technical training of the lead veterinarian, Dr. Daza, the follow-up was poor and communication practically nonexistent. In my opinion, she is taking on more cases than she can manage with the level of responsibility and compassion that animals and their caregivers deserve. Aside from that, it's a very good hospital with excellent professionals. They saved my dog's life during an emergency pyometra. I want to especially highlight the veterinarian Sofía (emergency room) and the assistant Ruth, whose treatment has always been impeccable: friendly, empathetic, and dedicated. The oncology team has also demonstrated very professional and compassionate care. Thank you for saving Luna's life. I hope this review helps to strengthen the nephrology team so they aren't so overwhelmed and can provide better care.
The best professionals you can find. True specialists in every field. Excellent treatment of animals. Nothing like what you'll find at any private clinic or veterinarian.
The doctors' treatment... Incredible! We are so happy and grateful for everything.

I don't have enough words to express my gratitude for the wonderful care my furry friends always receive from the team of professionals at this hospital.

A special thank you to Guadalupe Miró's team in the infectious diseases department. Thanks to them, my dog ​​Leo is still with us after finding the right treatment, undoubtedly thanks to the tenacity of Guadalupe Miró, Ana Montoya, Juliana Sarquís, Clara, and others. They are a truly amazing team of caring people who are so dedicated to their patients!

Best regards, Beatriz A.
Very professional and very loving with the animals.

Highly recommended. The treatment and dedication to the patient is exceptional; they are truly outstanding professionals, and future stars. And not only with the patients, but also with us, the owners. They explain everything masterfully and help you make the best decisions without seeking any personal gain—hats off to them. Don't rush; it's normal for consultations to be longer and for there to be delays. There might be a group of students with your pet listening to a professor's observations, or there might be other emergencies. As for the price, it's the most affordable you'll find.

In our case, we had to treat our dog for lymphoma with chemotherapy for eight months. Because he was already elderly, and thanks to their wide range of specialties, they were able to treat other age-related conditions. Ultimately, we had to say goodbye to him.
Fantastic service and fantastic professionals. Absolutely recommended...

Sadly, we have just lost our beloved Yuyi.
She was nearly nine years old and had been battling a severe chronic illness for the past four years.

We have only words of praise and deep gratitude for the entire team who cared for her these past four years, with monthly cycles and countless checkups.
Of the entire team, we would like to especially highlight Professor Dr. M. Porteo, Silvia in the inpatient ward, and Dr. DDiaz in gastroenterology.

All of them are magnificent professionals with exceptional clinical skills and immense compassion.
We couldn't have been in better hands. From the bottom of our hearts, our most sincere thanks.
Good

A fully equipped hospital with all the specialists.
During hospitalization, they take excellent care of the animals, walk them frequently, and dedicate time to explaining everything. They inspire confidence and tranquility, even when leaving them there "alone."

In my case, being a senior dog with multiple health issues, she has been hospitalized in other places and has never wanted to return after visits. But at this hospital, she would stay at the door waiting to be picked up. Unbelievable. You leave feeling reassured, knowing that if something happens, they will call you immediately, and above all, that they are attentive to each animal's schedule and needs. They respect your instructions, which seems "normal," but it hasn't been the case in other places.
Veterinarians and future veterinarians eager to work and learn. A 10 out of 10.
Excellent service
Very happy, they treated their pet wonderfully and saw things they hadn't seen at Vetsia after two years

I came in for an emergency because my dog ​​had diarrhea and wouldn't stop vomiting. The vet's response was, "We can't see her because she doesn't have a record."
My dog's life depends on a "record."
This hospital has excellent professionals. Both my pet and I were very happy; the veterinarians are very kind and caring with our furry friends. The prices are quite reasonable.
An excellent place to go when our pets need it. A fantastic multidisciplinary team; they have the resources and highly qualified staff. Thank you. Small public parking available.
